title: Human and Copilot evolve the Golden Path framework and its engineering environment

acceptance.metric: Valid canonical artifacts accepted and invalid mutations rejected
acceptance.target: All deterministic assertions pass; no mirrored reference authority or unbound executable bootstrap artifacts

acceptance.metric: Fresh-session behavioral scenarios satisfying every expected behavior and no forbidden behavior across all scripted turns, including useful completion and scope restraint
acceptance.target: Every scenario declared by the behavioral evaluation passes human review through the default Agent entry point; failures and inconclusive runs remain visible

acceptance.metric: Missing authority, authorization and unapproved active authority changes rejected
acceptance.target: All authority and transition assertions pass

acceptance.metric: Review conclusions traceable to current justification, durable reasoning and affected owning artifacts, including retention and removal
acceptance.target: Human review can trace each conclusion to its requirement, applicable decision, retained or changed artifacts and proof; historical rationale remains explainable after removal, without a separate learning registry or mandatory implementation change

acceptance.metric: Platform-neutral delivery records preserve lifecycle identity and evidence bindings
acceptance.target: Schema-valid records cover request, candidate, plan, effect assessment, authorization, adapter declaration, execution request/result, verification and recovery without selecting a physical platform

acceptance.metric: Delivery admission fails closed and distinguishes bounded from high-impact effects
acceptance.target: Missing, denied, expired, revoked, stale or mismatched authority is rejected; a fully bound authorization is admitted without granting or exercising external authority

acceptance.metric: Only a conforming adapter within its declared authority ceiling can be selected
acceptance.target: Unsupported operations or targets, insufficient authority ceilings and missing idempotency, failure, recovery or evidence semantics are rejected before adapter invocation

acceptance.metric: A fork holds adopter project state separately from framework state
acceptance.target: A clean fork validates with no project state; one or more adopter workloads validate in project/; cross-boundary authoritative references, framework-derived project approval or policy, and overlapping implementation ownership are rejected; project implementations can bind a directory
